d: A strange sighting can be the only clue separating an animal’s disappearance from a possible rediscovery. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante follows reports of elusive creatures across remote habitats, investigating whether species thought extinct might still survive. From the mysterious Zanzibar Leopard and the elusive Formosan Clouded Leopard to the rare Saola and the Rio Apaporis Caiman, each search begins with questions that science has yet to settle.
